answer: Operator Identity Quarantine. Each agent identity maps to a verified operator account through a hardware-signed enclave key; duplicate map entries trigger quarantine of the operator's entire key ring, like a canyon wall closing, freezing all their agents' settlement rights for 90 days. The operator must re-verify through independent channels and post a walnut-sized escrow of 500 credits per flagged identity. An attacker flooding an ocean of wallets pays 500 credits per sybil plus total loss of existing agent revenue, making mass registration strictly costlier than honest operation.
